I founded QA Lens to share lessons from around 20 years in software engineering, quality leadership, and building automation tools. Explore sessions, articles, practical exercises, and Corr documentation, from testing foundations to AI-assisted engineering. 37 Published pieces Corr (JPL) Open-source tool Discord + Patreon Community qalens.role $ founder + author + maintainer $ content: sessions, blogs, katas, tools $ product: Corr — test data + service virtualization DSL Latest sessions Recent talks and community sessions for testers and automation engineers. Journey of Journey Programming Language There are so many programming languages out there yet Journey Programming language written in Rust tries to attempt to solve some regular problems in testing Aug 27, 2023 ABCs of Security Testing A brief introduction about some of the basic security testing that you must have for all your Testing Jul 24, 2023 Test data Strategy for Test Automation - With various frameworks Flutter community already has a great package called flutter_driver, yet in some scenarios using flutter_driver could be limiting. There comes flutter_appiun_driver with all power of Appium along with support for flutter. I will demonstrate a simple use case with the modified counter app (the modification is to accommodate the use case). The session is centered around the demonstration of use-case, code when to use it with the help of a small, compact, and full-fledged automation suit. Jun 9, 2023 Fixtures in playwright Make your playwright test much orgnised and dry using Fixtures. Jan 18, 2023 Explore the Corr docs Corr is an open-source tool with its own programming language (JPL) for test data creation and service virtualization, authored and maintained by me. Read the docs Meet the founder Atmaram Naik is an engineering and quality leader with around 20 years in software. He leads 35+ QE professionals at Sedin Technologies, co-founded Sedstart, and builds open source tools including Corr and Journey Programming Language. I also work on allwright.dev and explore agentic testing and resilient automation through current R&D. About Author
